command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=56813b27f6dc1f93d4899974ffd47a1528d8b6b8
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller
test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
PORT=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'from tools.stage27c_soak import detect_ch340_port; print(detect_ch340_port())')
echo "STAGE28B_PORT=$PORT"
export PORT
export GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA="$EXPECTED"
export GROWBOX_STAGE27_SD_ENABLED=1
export GROWBOX_STAGE27_FLASH_FALLBACK_ENABLED=1
export GROWBOX_SD_CMD0_PRECONDITION=0
export GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED=1
export GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_AUTO_SMOKE=1
export GROWBOX_RF433_TX_GPIO=8
export GROWBOX_RF433_RX_GPIO=14
export STAGE27C_BUILD_DIR=build/idf-stage28b-rf-loopback-smoke-v1
scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash
OUT=/tmp/stage28b-rf-loopback-smoke-v1
rm -rf "$OUT"
.venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 150 --progress-seconds 30 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED" --require-sd --strict
echo STAGE28B_RF_LOOPBACK_SOAK_SUMMARY
cat "$OUT/summary.json"
.venv/bin/python - "$OUT" "$EXPECTED" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
out = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected_sha = sys.argv[2]
summary = json.loads((out / 'summary.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert summary.get('passed') is True, summary
assert summary.get('firmware_sha') == expected_sha, summary.get('firmware_sha')
assert int(summary.get('records', 0)) >= 10, summary.get('records')
assert int(summary.get('resets', 0)) == 0, summary.get('resets')
assert int(summary.get('serial_disconnects', 0)) == 0, summary.get('serial_disconnects')
assert int(summary.get('max_scd_read_errors', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_scd_read_errors')
assert int(summary.get('max_scd_invalid', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_scd_invalid')
assert int(summary.get('max_rtc_read_errors', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_rtc_read_errors')
assert int(summary.get('max_rtc_untrusted', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_rtc_untrusted')
assert int(summary.get('max_ble_scan_errors', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_ble_scan_errors')
assert int(summary.get('max_ble_adv_lock_drops', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_ble_adv_lock_drops')
assert int(summary.get('max_sd_mount_errors', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_sd_mount_errors')
assert int(summary.get('max_sd_write_errors', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_sd_write_errors')
assert int(summary.get('max_sd_queue_drops', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_sd_queue_drops')
assert int(summary.get('max_sd_records_skipped', 0)) == 0, summary.get('max_sd_records_skipped')
lines = []
for raw_path in sorted(out.glob('raw-*.log')):
    for line in raw_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines():
        if 'rf433_loopback_v=1 ' in line:
            lines.append(line)
assert lines, 'rf433_loopback_v=1 line not captured'
print('STAGE28B_RF_LINES', len(lines))
print(lines[-1])
payload = lines[-1].split('rf433_loopback_v=1 ', 1)[1]
fields = {}
for token in payload.split():
    if '=' in token:
        key, value = token.split('=', 1)
        fields[key] = value
def iv(name):
    return int(fields[name], 0)
assert iv('pass') == 1, fields
assert iv('requested_code') == 0xA55A, fields
assert iv('requested_bits') == 16, fields
assert iv('requested_protocol') == 1, fields
assert iv('requested_repeat') == 3, fields
assert iv('tx_queued') == 1 and iv('tx_started') == 1 and iv('tx_completed') == 1, fields
assert iv('rx_captured') == 1, fields
assert iv('decode_status') == 0, fields
assert iv('decoded_code') == 0xA55A, fields
assert iv('decoded_bits') == 16, fields
assert iv('decoded_protocol') == 1, fields
assert iv('observed_repeats') >= 1, fields
assert iv('classification') == 1, fields
for name in ('tx_queue_errors','tx_wait_errors','rx_arm_errors','rx_timeouts','rx_decode_failures','rx_ambiguous','rx_interference'):
    assert iv(name) == 0, (name, fields)
assert iv('rx_self_tx') >= 1, fields
assert fields.get('outputs') == 'fake-locked', fields
print('STAGE28B_RF_LOOPBACK_SMOKE_OK', {'records': summary.get('records'), 'min_heap_internal': summary.get('min_heap_internal'), 'min_stack_free': summary.get('min_stack_free'), 'rf': fields})
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
